_comment: Add/remove projects freely — the site re-renders from this file on every load, nothing else needs touching. Set 'featured': true on the ones that should get a large vertebra of their own; the rest render together in the compact 'T-series' index card. Order in this array is the order they rotate past on the spine.

projects.name: Thermite
projects.tagline: Cloud Rust compiler with no application server.
projects.description: Fe2O3 + 2Al -> Al2O3 + 2Fe + heat. Compiles Rust on GitHub's own hosted runners, in your account, on your quota, and hands you a binary for any of eleven targets -- optionally sealed end to end with a key only you hold. The site itself is a static page with no backend of its own.

projects.name: Example Project (replace or delete me)
projects.tagline: One line describing what it does and why it exists.
projects.description: A longer description shown on the project's own vertebra when it is marked featured, or in the compact index otherwise. Plain text or simple sentences are safest -- this is rendered as-is, no markdown parsing here (use the docs system below for long-form writeups).

patents.abstract: One or two sentences on what the patent covers. Shown as-is on the L-series (lumbar) vertebra.
